items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never did. I didn’t know much about his music. I just knew him, because he died quite a few years ago, didn’t he?

ctx.x: Some of the exponents, in addition to someone like Paul Bley, maybe Herbie Nichols or someone like that.
Yeah, Herbie Nichols. There’s a good example.
And also Cecil Taylor. Did you know . . . I know you know Cecil. Did you know Herbie Nichols very well or at all?
